item.title: Cyberattack wipes cloud data at major Russian hosting provider Beget
item.description: A major Russian web hosting provider is struggling to restore its services after a cyberattack destroyed data across its cloud infrastructure and disrupted hundreds of websites.

item.title: France Blood Service Cyber-Attack Sends Blood Storage Temperatures to 110°C
item.description: A supplier of the French National Blood Service was hit by a cyber-attack in which hackers turned cold rooms hosting blood samples up to 110°C (230°F)

item.title: Impart uses AI to build virtual patches without putting models in the traffic path
item.description: Impart Security has launched the Runtime Defense Harness, a controlled environment where AI agents write and test virtual patches for new vulnerabilities without putting AI in the traffic path. The launch comes as exploits increasingly outpace fixes. In the harness, agents build each virtual patch against the customer’s own traffic, an engineer approves it, and Impart’s engine enforces it as deterministic code. item.title: ZDI-26-869: MailEnable Save Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Creation Vulnerability
item.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create arbitrary files on affected installations of MailEnable. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.4. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-114556.
